note: Fall 2025 (Revised), the last term of the university-wide bi-semester calendar (Spring 2023 to Fall 2025): 17 teaching weeks, 75-minute classes. Kept because a transcript from 2023-2025 counts its terms on this calendar. Its last row starts Spring 2026 on 7 Jan 2026; the Spring 2026 calendar (bubt-calendar-261), issued later, starts it on 1 Jan, which is the date in 261-trimester.json. Club, wellbeing, census, parents', sports and research-showcase weeks and staff deadlines are left out. classes-pause is the last class before the mid-term, not the end of teaching.
